reason: A settings navigation panel that provides a curated plugin marketplace, lists skills and installed plugins, and supports review-oriented installation handoff plus local enable, disable, and uninstall actions.

summaries.zh: 一个在设置中提供精选插件市场、技能列表和已安装插件管理功能的导航面板，并将安装审查交接给会话中的 Agent。
summaries.en: A settings navigation panel for browsing curated plugins, viewing skills and installed plugins, and handing installation review to an agent session.

capabilities: Reads a remote plugin catalog from configured GitHub or Gitee sources when enabled
Displays curated plugins, installed plugin status, and session-resolvable skills
Opens a new session and inserts an installation review prompt without sending it
Enables or disables installed plugins through local profile configuration
Uninstalls user plugins by invoking pnpm remove in the profile directory
